body.statement: For each \(r\in\mathcal R\), the affine high-hazard construction satisfies the declared assumptions for all sufficiently large \(n\): \(\bar q_H\in\mathcal Q\), the profile errors vanish after the cutoff, and its deterministic early rare-arm quadratic-variation envelope is \(O(M^2\varepsilon_n^2+M^2/n)\).
body.justification: The favorable subclass must be legal under the same primitive design and profile requirements used by the coverage theorem.
body.gap: No cited result verifies an affine critical-hazard finite-population subclass with an explicit vanishing early-variation envelope.
body.consumer: The membership result prevents the \(0.442M\) comparison from relying on an oracle or inadmissible subclass.
